Verify that the dorsal fin is short and rounded with 3-4 unbranched and 8-9 branched rays. Check for any fusion between the fish's body and the angler's hands. Ensure the fish is clearly separated from the hands and that the spatial grounding is correct. Verify the body depth is approximately 3-4 times the standard length. Check for the complete lateral line running mid-laterally from operculum to caudal peduncle. Verify the eye coloration is reddish-orange with small eyes positioned laterally.
